# nico_health_report (Data Source)

Machine Health Report contains information about the health of a Machine including user enforced overrides

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_health_report" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "health_report_name" {
  value = data.nico_health_report.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `machine_id` (String) Path parameter: machine_id.

### Read-Only

- `alerts` (Attributes List) Results from failed health probes for the Machine. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))
- `mode` (String) How this health report was updated
- `observed_at` (String) Date/time when the health report was observed.
- `source` (String) Health report source.
- `successes` (Attributes List) Results from successful health probes for the Machine. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--successes))
- `triggered_by` (String) Person or system that triggered this health report.

<a id="nestedatt--alerts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alerts`

Read-Only:

- `classifications` (List of String) Classifications for this alert, category or impact
- `id` (String) Health probe identifier
- `in_alert_since` (String) Date/time since the alert has been in effect
- `message` (String) Details of the failed health probe result
- `target` (String) Specific component targeted by health probe
- `tenant_message` (String) Information provided by Tenant, if any


<a id="nestedatt--successes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `successes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Health probe identifier
- `target` (String) Specific component targeted by health probe
